name: VBrowser
tagline: Find and save videos playing on any website
description:
VBrowser is a web browser built to find and save the videos that play inside web pages as you browse. Instead of hunting for a separate download link, it sniffs out video streams on the site you're viewing so you can save them to your phone.

It keeps a local cache of what you've found, making it handy for grabbing clips and videos from across the web while you browse normally.
